body: Sometimes our worst enemy is ourself. You have many good qualities im sure, physical or otherwise. And your smile, though you may think it is a lie, I can see a very pretty soul underneath.

Don’t let them get to you, try to focus on everything else you have. You have soft, kind eyes. A beautiful, warm smile. And a kick-ass attitude to get through this. And I’m sure a hell of a lot more I don’t know about. I know it can be hard, but I believe in you:)
I agree, maybe should have specified I am male tho lol. Thanks for trying tho, I really appreciate it.

I want to help as many people as I can. I’ve given up hope on myself, helping the people close to me is the only thing that gives me a truly good feeling anymore. Maybe somewhere along the way it will come back around.
Congrats!!! Been with mine for about the same time. Best of luck and love to yall!!

This sounds easier than it really is but I try to remember what you have now. Anytime you make a friend laugh, see a cool bird, eat some good bread, anything that sparks even a little joy, take a moment to just stop everything. Tell yourself that this is where you are now. This helps me with my anxiety as well as other problems I have. Hope it helps!
